final_netlist:
.subckt dut vin vout vref vss ibias
* bias: IREF -> NMOS diode -> PMOS diode -> PMOS tail
Mb1   ibias ibias vss  vss  nfet W=4  L=1
Mb2   pb    ibias vss  vss  nfet W=4  L=1
Mp1   pb    pb    vin  vin  pfet W=10 L=1 m=4
Mp2   tail  pb    vin  vin  pfet W=10 L=1 m=4
* error amplifier: PMOS input pair (bulk = common source), NMOS mirror load
Mi1   d1    vref  tail tail pfet W=10 L=1 m=4
Mi2   na    fb    tail tail pfet W=10 L=1 m=4
Mn3   d1    d1    vss  vss  nfet W=4  L=1
Mn4   na    d1    vss  vss  nfet W=4  L=1
* gain stage + PMOS diode mirrored into pass device (1:120)
Mbuf  g     na    vss  vss  nfet W=4  L=1 m=2
Md    g     g     vin  vin  pfet W=10 L=0.15
Mpass vout  g     vin  vin  pfet W=10 L=0.15 m=120
* feedback divider (Vout = 2*Vref) and output reservoir
R1    vout  fb    60k
R2    fb    vss   60k
C1    vout  vss   1u
C2    vout  vss   1u
.ends
